name: SM Easy Post Migrator
author: steviemathew

sections.description:
SM Easy Post Migrator helps you move your WordPress content from one site to another. Use it to migrate posts, pages, images, and other media files between WordPress sites without losing your content or breaking links.

What You Can Do:

  • Migrate Posts and Pages: Copy your blog posts, pages, and content from your old site to your new site. All your text, formatting, and content structure is preserved.

  • Move Images and Media: Automatically download and import all images, videos, and media files from your source site. The plugin checks for duplicates so you don’t end up with multiple copies of the same file.

  • Fix Internal Links: When you move content, all the links between your posts and pages are automatically updated to work on your new site. No broken links!

  • Choose What to Migrate: Browse your source site and pick exactly which posts, pages, or media files you want to move. You’re in control.

  • Track Your Progress: See detailed logs of what was migrated, what succeeded, and what had issues. Export these logs to CSV if you need to review them later.

  • Easy to Use: Connect to your source site using your WordPress username and application password, then select what you want to migrate. The plugin handles the rest.

Perfect for moving your blog to a new domain, consolidating multiple sites, or backing up your content to a new location.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/content-migration-pro directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Content Migrator’ in the admin menu.
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions to connect to your source site and start migrating content.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin migrate users or comments?

No, SM Easy Post Migrator focuses on posts, pages, media, and internal links. User and comment migration is not supported in this version.

What are the requirements?

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • REST API enabled on the source site
  • Application password for secure connection

Can I migrate custom post types?

Currently, the plugin supports standard posts, pages, and media. Support for custom post types is planned for a future release.

How are internal links handled?

The plugin automatically detects and remaps internal links to match the new site structure, including media URLs.
